development_delta_ni.rule: 0.03 x the Phase R incumbent (champion+v8) scripted mean H5000 mass, all 160 worlds; the binding delta_NI is 0.03 x the calibration incumbent scripted mean

joint_bootstrap.method: resample Phase R world indices jointly across mixes (N_max per replicate), both arms' H5000 survival from the same worlds, a 16-world calibration delta_NI resampled per replicate (0.03 x incumbent scripted mass); survival band v2 (pooled_ni_continue: pooled M 0.05, per-mix 0.075, alpha 0.05 rci_obf, floor 0.30) judged at the qualifying look and every later look, a qualified run whose bands fail continues; futility followed before qualification; 'survival_deltas' = observed, or the candidate's survival recentred on the incumbent's at the stated true deltas (what-if)

mac_fallback_runtime.basis: v8 strict run-v1 final records of its champion+v8 arm (Mac, 2 slots, live H5000, 561 episodes); the FRP-v3 candidate at x1.25 (Phase R: about 1.2x the v8 work per episode, bigger bodies); x1.15 overhead
mac_fallback_runtime.note: disclosed, not a sizing constraint (the owner's rule is N_max <= 300): the Mac fallback at N_max projects to this fraction of the template's final-stage cap; a cap reached ends the run INCOMPLETE

normal_monte_carlo.method: simulate.py Replica/summarize/part_mc reused unchanged; normal deltas with the candidate's own per-mix SDs; efficacy and NI only (bands not simulated)

sizing.basis: candidate's own Phase R paired SDs (binding)
sizing.rule: per-mix SD = sample SD of the candidate's own FRP-v3 Phase R paired H5000 deltas (training seed 12, M3@60000 minus champion+v8, 32 worlds per mix); sd_max = max over mixes; n_fixed(MDE) = smallest n with n >= ((t_{1-0.05/3, n-1} + t_{0.90, n-1}) * sd_max / MDE)^2 (one-sided per-mix Bonferroni alpha, 90% per-mix power at the MDE in every mix); N_max(MDE) = ceil(1.02 * n_fixed) (amendment: four OBF looks); MDE = the smallest multiple of 5 with N_max <= 300. The Phase R mean deltas are not used for sizing.

skew_check_prerun.status: planning only, not the binding check (that runs in the strict run after calibration, with the calibrated delta_NI, through the frozen probe)
